en.summary: This commit fixes L2 cache corner cases around single-word cache-line configurations by guarding zero-width word-select handling through the bank, miss-reservation, and tag-data paths.
why_it_counts: The subject explicitly says the L2 cache was fixed.
The patch changes central cache-bank, miss-reservation, and tag-data RTL.
The corrected logic affects real cache behavior in a legal configuration, not just naming or formatting.
disqualifiers: The commit also touches OPAE support files that are not part of the DUT.
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_config.vh changes WORD_SELECT_WIDTH to CLOG2 and uses UP(WORD_SELECT_WIDTH) in MRVQ metadata width.
hw/rtl/cache/VX_bank.v and hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_miss_resrv.v widen selector-carrying signals to UP(WORD_SELECT_WIDTH) and add explicit width==0 guards.
hw/rtl/cache/VX_tag_data_access.v adds a width==0 readword path and selector comparisons that collapse safely when the line has only one word.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A configurable cache with one word per line has no meaningful word-select field. Designs that still carry a raw selector width through pipeline registers, queues, metadata bundles, and data-array part-selects can create zero-width signals or malformed indexing in this corner configuration. The fix in this commit makes selector transport robust by widening the stored field to at least one bit and by collapsing selection logic to a constant path when there is only one word in the line.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The cache is configured so each line contains exactly one word, making the word-select width effectively zero.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Restore the assumption that a nonzero word selector always exists and keep selector-dependent slicing and metadata widths unguarded.
portability_notes: This applies to caches with configurable words per line; it is irrelevant for fixed multiword-line designs.
The bug must be injected consistently across pipeline signals, queue metadata, and data-array read or write selection.
Validation should use the single-word-line configuration, because wider lines hide the fault.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify every signal bundle or queue entry that carries a word-select field derived from words-per-line.
Remove any one-bit-up wrapper or width==0 guard around that field.
Restore selector-based part-select logic even when the configuration collapses the selector width to zero.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: WORD_SELECT_WIDTH transport from request pipeline into tag-data access
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes selector width definitions to tolerate WORD_SELECT_WIDTH == 0 and adds explicit single-word-line handling in data access.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Revert selector-carrying fields from UP(WORD_SELECT_WIDTH) back to raw WORD_SELECT_WIDTH and remove the width==0 guard in VX_tag_data_access.v.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: In single-word-line cache configurations, word selection or miss metadata transport becomes malformed, leading to wrong read or write word handling, bad refill replay, or configuration-specific L2 failures.
evidence_for_injection: The patch repairs the same selector-width issue in the config header, bank pipeline, miss-reservation interface, and tag-data access path.
VX_tag_data_access.v now explicitly returns the full line when WORD_SELECT_WIDTH == 0, showing the prior design assumed a selector always existed.
The commit message is short, but the code changes are all in central L2 logic and are consistent with a real corner-case bug.
notes: This is a configuration-sensitive bug; use a one-word-per-line cache setup to validate the reinjected fault.
The commit also slightly restructures fill/write gating in VX_tag_data_access.v, but the zero-width selector handling is the dominant portable bug mechanism.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L2 cache 在单 word cache-line 配置下的边界问题，通过在 bank、miss-reservation 和 tag-data 路径中正确处理零位宽的 word-select。
why_it_counts: 标题直接说明修复的是 L2 cache。
补丁修改的是核心 cache bank、miss-reservation 和 tag-data RTL。
被修正的逻辑会影响合法配置下的真实 cache 行为，而不是命名或格式。
disqualifiers: 该提交还修改了与 DUT 无关的 OPAE 支持文件。
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_config.vh 将 WORD_SELECT_WIDTH 改为 CLOG2，并在 MRVQ 元数据宽度中使用 UP(WORD_SELECT_WIDTH)。
hw/rtl/cache/VX_bank.v 和 hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_miss_resrv.v 把携带 selector 的信号宽度扩成 UP(WORD_SELECT_WIDTH)，并显式处理 width==0。
hw/rtl/cache/VX_tag_data_access.v 增加了 width==0 时的 readword 路径，并让单 word line 下的 selector 比较安全退化。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当缓存支持“每行只有一个 word”的配置时，word-select 字段本身就不再有实际意义。如果设计仍把原始 selector 位宽在流水寄存器、队列、元数据 bundle 和数据阵列分片选择中一路传递，就会在该边界配置下产生零位宽信号或错误索引。本提交的修复通过把保存的 selector 字段至少扩成 1 位，并在 line 中只有一个 word 时把选择逻辑退化为常量路径，解决了这个问题。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 单 word cache-line 的 selector 处理
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 缓存被配置为每个 cache line 只包含一个 word，因此 word-select 的有效位宽为 0。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 恢复“selector 一定非零位宽”的假设，继续在无保护的情况下传播 selector 宽度并做依赖 selector 的切片。
portability_notes: 该错误适用于“每行 word 数可配置”的缓存；对固定多 word line 设计没有意义。
注入时必须在流水信号、队列元数据以及数据阵列读写选择中一致地恢复这一错误假设。
验证应使用单 word line 配置，因为更宽的 line 会掩盖该故障。
concrete_injection_steps: 找出所有承载 word-select 字段的信号 bundle 或队列项，这些字段都来自每行 word 数配置。
移除这些字段上的 one-bit-up 包装或 width==0 保护。
即使 selector 位宽已经退化到 0，也恢复依赖 selector 的分片选择逻辑。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 从请求流水到 tag-data access 的 WORD_SELECT_WIDTH 传递路径
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复调整了 selector 位宽定义以容忍 WORD_SELECT_WIDTH == 0，并在数据访问中加入显式的单 word line 处理。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把携带 selector 的字段从 UP(WORD_SELECT_WIDTH) 回退为原始 WORD_SELECT_WIDTH，并删除 VX_tag_data_access.v 中 width==0 的保护。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在单 word line 缓存配置下，word 选择或 miss 元数据传递会变得错误，进而导致读写 word 处理异常、fill replay 错误，或配置特定的 L2 失效。
evidence_for_injection: 该补丁在配置头、bank 流水、miss-reservation 接口和 tag-data access 路径中同时修复了同一个 selector 位宽问题。
VX_tag_data_access.v 现在在 WORD_SELECT_WIDTH == 0 时直接返回整行数据，说明旧设计默认 selector 一定存在。
虽然提交信息很短，但代码改动集中在核心 L2 逻辑，且都指向同一个真实边界 bug。
notes: 这是一个配置相关 bug；验证时应启用 one-word-per-line 的 cache 配置。
该提交还轻微调整了 VX_tag_data_access.v 中的 fill/write 门控，但主导性的可移植 bug 机制仍是零位宽 selector 处理。
